Cursed Mark.name: Cursed Mark
Cursed Mark.description:
Trigger A creature in range damages you.

You imbue the target cursed power, causing them to succumb more easily. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target gains a cursed mark on their body that lasts for 1 round. While the target has the mark on their body, the next saving throw they attempt they must roll twice and take the worse result. After this saving throw, the mark disappears. The target can spend a single Interact action to remove the mark.

Failure As success, except the mark lasts for 1 minute. 

Critical Failure As failure, except the target must spend at least 2 Interact actions to remove the mark.

State of the Art.name: State of the Art
State of the Art.description:
Area a number of cubes per action spent to Cast this Spell.

You create a construction to perform a task. A construction is made in each of the 10-foot cubes that performs the action listed for your choice when you Cast this spell and each time you Sustain the spell on subsequent turns. If you spent more than 1 action to Cast this spell, you can Sustain this spell multiple times per turn on subsequent turns, choosing a different construction to use its action each time. For any checks your construction makes, it uses your spell attack modifier.

Analysis Construction Your construction attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} against a creature within 30 feet of it. If it successfully detects a creature within the area of its Seek, it learns which of the enemy’s weaknesses is highest, which of the enemy’s saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy’s resistances is highest.

Forceful Construction Your construction attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} a creature within 10 feet of it.

Restricting Construction Your construction attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a creature within 10 feet of it.

Smoke Construction Your construction spews smoke in a 10-foot emanation. All creatures within the smoke become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within it. Each time you Sustain this spell and target this construction, the smoke emanation increases by 5 feet.

Mantle of Nobility.name: Mantle of Nobility
Mantle of Nobility.description:
You take on the seal of a noble whom you serve with a small crowd of illusory survitors. You gain the appearance of nobility, granting you a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks and a small crowd of illusory followers in a 5-foot emanation. The crowd of followers acts as a crowd and is difficult terrain. Creatures that attempt to move through the crowd can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. Abilities and effects that work on crowds work on your illusory servitors.

@UUID[Compendium.clerics-remaster.clerics-effects.Item.vOOBUyShmhdrQdaP]{Effect: Mantle of Nobility}

Virtue's Light.name: Virtue's Light
Virtue's Light.description:
You hold your holy symbol high, allowing it to glow a light that dispels wickedness and despair. All unholy creatures within the emanation gain weakness to holy equal to twice the spell’s level. If they already had a weakness to holy, its weakness is increased by the same amount.

@UUID[Compendium.clerics-remaster.clerics-effects.Item.qblHDaq9VTKUYQAQ]{Effect: Virtue's Light}

Ruler of Everything.name: Ruler of Everything
Ruler of Everything.description:
Your magic evokes nobility and causes others to bend the knee. All enemy creatures within the area must attempt a Will save. Creatures that are of nobility themselves or that serve nobility directly, such as a royal guard, receive a +2 circumstance bonus to their saves. Regardless of the result, creatures are temporarily immune to this spell for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone}. The creature can spend its reaction to rebuke your claim of nobility, allowing them to avoid this effect.

Failure The creature must Drop Prone and it cannot take hostile actions against you unless you or your allies take hostile actions against it.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature cannot Stand up until you or one of your allies takes a hostile action against it or you move further than 15 feet away from them.

Honorable Death.name: Honorable Death
Honorable Death.description:
You open your opponent's eyes to the inevitability of their demise, and offer them a valiant end in the eyes of your deity. Choose yourself or an ally within 30 feet and the target must attempt a Will save. A creature that is reduced to 0 Hit Points while this spell is active is instantly killed and their soul is transported to the domain of your deity to become a shade or appropriate entity there.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell ends.

Success If the target does not take a hostile action against you or your chosen ally by the end of its turn, it takes spirit damage equal to twice this spell’s rank with a basic Will save and then the spell ends.

Failure As success, except the creature takes damage at the end of each of its turns for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Critical Failure As failure, except the duration is 1 minute.

Residual Bad Luck.name: Residual Bad Luck
Residual Bad Luck.description:
You flood the target with visions of bad luck, causing them apprehension for failure. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If the target fails an attack roll or skill check before the end of their next turn, they do not reduce their frightened condition by 1 at the end of their turn. 

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is frightened 2.

Repairomancy.name: Repairomancy
Repairomancy.description:
Trigger An object you can see would gain the broken condition.

You restore the items you target to form. The target object regains 5 Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) Increase the Hit Points regained by 5.

If Walls Could Talk.name: If Walls Could Talk
If Walls Could Talk.description:
You commune with ruins, learning of their ancient past with ease. Ruins can include a ruined city, a haunted house, abandoned tomb, or other similar constructed place (subject to GM discretion). If anyone has previously cast this spell on an overlapping area within the last day, the spell automatically fails. The GM rolls a secret Will save for the ruins using a Will save modifier equal to 4 plus the highest level enemy creature, haunt, or unattended item within the area that you are unaware of.

Success The ruins does not to grant you any information. The ruins can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to your questions if they would consider you unwelcome (subject to GM discretion). 

Failure The ruins whisper answers into your mind. You learn whether there are enemy creatures, haunts, or unattended items nearby, your choice. The ruins will not give you exact details or numbers, but it will tell you the general direction and a vague sense of the power of your choice.

Critical Failure As failure, except you can make an additional choice between creatures, haunts, or unattended items.

Fall to Ruin.name: Fall to Ruin
Fall to Ruin.description:
Area 4 contiguous 5-foot squares of a constructed ceiling, floor, or wall

You call upon the ravages of time to claim the works of man and bring them to ruin. Each square you affect is given the appropriate effect from the list below depending on if it was a ceiling, floor, or wall. You can Sustain the spell to add an additional 4 contiguous 5-foot squares, but you cannot target the same square more than once with this spell. These effects remain after you Cast the spell, but they can usually be Repaired within 10 minutes.

Ceilings The ceiling caves in, doing 4d6 bludgeoning damage to anyone standing beneath it.

Floors The floors become aged and unstable. They become difficult terrain.

Walls The walls crack and become easy to crumble. Their hardness is reduced to half the spell’s rank.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and the time to Repair the damage increases by 10 minutes.

Divine Adjudication.name: Divine Adjudication
Divine Adjudication.description:
You stare into the soul of your enemy, seeking out sins against your deity. The target takes 1d8 spirit damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell ends.

Success The target takes half damage and the spell ends.

Failure You scour through the wrongdoings of your opponent, causing divine power to whip their soul. The target takes full damage. If the target has committed any serious acts of anathema to your deity within the last week (or even further back for egregious acts), you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure Your judgment is absolute. As a failure, but you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The spirit damage is increased by 1d8.

Planar Court.name: Planar Court
Planar Court.description:
You teleport yourself and your target to a court in another plane to rule on the fate of your opponent’s soul. You and your opponent vanish from the field until the start of their next turn. The court battle is often long and arduous for yourself and your opponent, though for others it appears in only a single instant. You accuse the target of a transgression before the planar court, choosing one of its ability attributes to be punished in recompense and the target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success Not only are your claims refuted, but they shed doubt on your own soul in front of the jury. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. 

Success The target leaves the planar court satisfied. They are unaffected and the spell ends.

Failure The court finds that your accusation has merit. The court punishes the target of your spell and the creature takes a –1 status penalty to all checks, DCs, and saves of the ability attribute you chose for as long as you Sustain the spell.

Critical Failure The court lambasts the target, proclaiming them undeniably guilty. As failure, except the status penalty is –2.

Sacrosanct Promise.name: Sacrosanct Promise
Sacrosanct Promise.description:
You shake hands with your target, promising to complete an agreed action so long as they complete another action in exchange. This declared action is usually something that can be stated in a single sentence and has a clear criteria, such as “take this box to the innkeeper” or “be at the dock at sunset”. Once the action is completed, the other party immediately becomes aware of its completion and gains a +1 status bonus to its next check that would further its completion of its own declared action. If it is unclear whether the action was completed or not, the GM decides whether the action was sufficiently completed. Once both actions have been completed, the spell ends.

If either of you fail to complete the action, the other becomes aware of it after the duration elapses. You cannot recover the Focus Point spent on this spell until the spell ends.

Heightened (7th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Liberator's Ferocity.name: Liberator's Ferocity
Liberator's Ferocity.description:
Trigger You would take damage from a creature who has authority over you, either from their position or by law.

You withstand the call of the grave by clinging to the ideals of liberation. You gain resistance to all damage equal to twice the spell’s rank against the triggering attack and a status bonus to damage equal to the same amount against the triggering creature for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.clerics-remaster.clerics-effects.Item.zGMYLv9wqNV74xj8]{Effect: Liberator's Ferocity}

Hope Prevails.name: Hope Prevails
Hope Prevails.description:
You disperse overwhelming hope into the target creature, attempting to soothe their fears and woes. You immediately reduce the target’s @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition by 2. If this would reduce the frightened condition to 0 and the condition was caused by an ongoing effect, you can attempt to counteract a single fear effect that the target suffers from. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2  (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. The target also gains a +2 status bonus to saves against fear effects for 1 minute. @UUID[Compendium.clerics-remaster.clerics-effects.Item.ePFN29cDDvUqLuQc]{Effect: Hope Prevails}

3 (concentrate) You share feelings of hope in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. This targets all creatures in the burst.

Long Live the Revolution.name: Long Live the Revolution
Long Live the Revolution.description:
You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Choose an act of rebellion, such as storming a castle, freeing captives, or destroying a monument. Targets who notice your speech, song, or other call to action must attempt a Will save or be spirited to engage in your act of rebellion. You must choose an act that would overthrow an authority and be possible for the creatures you are targeting to accomplish together or your spell automatically fails.

Creatures can choose to gain the effects of a failure on this spell and forgo their Will save and creatures that would be in conflict with your act of rebellion, such as the guards of a monarch during a civilian uprising, gain a +4 circumstance bonus to their save (subject to GM discretion).

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. Creatures that succeed at their save or remove the effect are immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and on subsequent turns they grant creatures within range a +1 circumstance bonus to their saves. This circumstance bonus is cumulative with other creatures that critically succeed their save up to a maximum of a +4 circumstance bonus.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is fascinated with the act of rebellion and gains a +1 status bonus to checks to complete your act of rebellion. The targets attitude towards creatures that oppose the act of rebellion decreases by one step. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, these effects end immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but attempts to use Diplomacy or Intimidation against it do not end the effects.

From Thine Sight.name: From Thine Sight
From Thine Sight.description:
You render an object completely invisible unless a creature possesses a specific characteristic you set. You make the target object @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, except to creatures with a specific belief you set, and you must set a characteristic that could reasonably be held by someone. For instance, you could state that followers of Desna can see the object, but you could not specify followers of a god that does not exist or that you are unaware of (subject to GM discretion). This spell otherwise functions as invisible object.

Heightened (+2) The Bulk of the object you can target increases by 1.

Heretic's Disguise.name: Heretic's Disguise
Heretic's Disguise.description:
You wrap yourself in divine energies that allow you to take certain liberties and prevent you from being discovered when walking amongst your deities enemies. You alter your clothing, items, and small aspects of your appearance so that you look like a member of a specific cult, faction, or organization. Your illusory clothing and items grant you a +4 circumstance bonus to attempts to Impersonate being a member of the organization and even if you are not recognized by members of the organization, you are generally given a chance to make your case as being a new or lesser known member. You gain a +2 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to Sense Motive if the creature attempting to Sense Motive is a member of the organization of your disguise.

If you follow a deity, you gain the ability to perform acts that violate your deities edicts and anathema without angering your god or losing your abilities, but you must be under duress or at risk of being discovered by your deities enemies when performing these acts, otherwise the normal repercussions for your actions apply (subject to GM discretion).

@UUID[Compendium.clerics-remaster.clerics-effects.Item.q05kPdAVtyGYX90K]{Effect: Heretic's Disguise}
